title: Evergreen upgrade check v1
description: Whether a repository's resolved dependencies support a target runtime, with the exact evidence behind every issue.

runtime.description: Runtime id, such as dart, flutter, nodejs, python, php, or go.

version.description: Target version as written, such as 3.5 or 22.

verdict.description: blocked when any blocker was reported; unknown when no analyzer applied. unknown is not a statement that the upgrade is safe.

analyzers.description: Ids of the analyzers that judged this target, sorted.

level.description: blocker: will not install or run on the target. warning: works but is deprecated there. unknown: the evidence needed is missing.

value.description: The lockfile or manifest value as written, or a lifecycle rule id.
